snippet.title: Knightstones - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3543400/Knightstones/

Knightstones is a highly replayable tacitcal battler game.
Lead your Sacred Order, develop your defenses, and repel the Lords of the Inquisition.

Music by Raoul MacCamley,  @attentionlabel 
Sound Design by Damien Combe / Nox Sound
Key Art & Logo by Jonas Champoiral

Website: https://www.willgreenstudio.com
